card.name: Start of pre-/hypo- medical words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that starts with pre-, prem-, hypo- or meta-, such as 'pre' in preterm or 'Prem' in Premedicate. It fires right after the word begins, before the rest is spelled out.

modes.label: Pre- words
modes.description: The pre- or prem- start of words like preterm, premature, premedicate and pre-renal.

modes.description: The middle piece of long terms such as hypocapnia, hypoparathyroidism and metathalamus.
